title: Read the description carefully
text: Read the description carefully. Sadly I only paid attention to the picture which shows 4 of the hooks. The description clearly states you only get two. That is totally my fault for thinking I would get 4. I purchased these for an upcoming move for next year. I am an over planner. I like to do things in advance. When I opened the box I was very disappointed. Of course it is only 2 and not 4. That is not where my disappointment lies. These hooks are super small. I am not sure what is going to hang on them beside a small throw. I thought they would be a lot bigger. I was also hoping for something that really stands out. At the size that they are, this is not it. I can't speak on anything else as they have not been installed and won't be until next year. Honestly due to the size alone, I will probably look for bigger hooks and just use these for dog leash hooks. Will update once I install next year and how I like them.
